rtl_result.summary: Patched mv_npu_top row-to-postproc handoff with a strict one-entry decoupling buffer and removed circular mat_ready dependence on buffered row valid; row capture now occurs only on accepted final matrix chunk and buffer clears only on confirmed postproc acceptance.

files.purpose: Functional repair of compute-to-postproc handshake coupling causing mat_ready stalls and row timing corruption.

contract_checks.evidence: Changed only mv_npu_top; protected modules untouched.

contract_checks.requirement: Row completion buffered and forwarded to postproc via decoupled valid/ready semantics.
contract_checks.evidence: row_buf_valid/data hold final row result; pp_in_valid=row_buf_valid; clear only on row_buf_pop=row_buf_valid&&pp_in_ready.

contract_checks.requirement: Final row sum captured only on accepted last matrix chunk.
contract_checks.evidence: row_buf_push derived from mat_xfer && mat_is_last_chunk; row_buf_data loaded only in that branch.

contract_checks.requirement: No circular control causing permanent mat ingress block.
contract_checks.evidence: mat_ready tied to compute phase/vector-loaded/error-free and single-entry buffer availability (!row_buf_valid), not directly to transient hold of postproc output signals.

contract_checks.requirement: Preserve ready/valid transfer rule and top-level interface.
contract_checks.evidence: All channel xfer pulses remain valid&&ready; top module ports/parameters unchanged.

known_risks: Existing warnings/lint issues in protected modules (e.g., mv_mac16_core latch warnings, width warnings) remain and may still affect behavior outside this scoped repair.
